title: History on the Hudson: 250 Years of Hudson County History - Battle of Bull's Ferry
description:
Date: Thursday, September 3, 2026
Time: 6:30pm - 8:00pm
Presenter: Patrick Cullen
Location: PGML - Fourth Floor Multipurpose Room

The Hudson County Office of Cultural and Heritage Affairs, in conjunction with the New Jersey Room of the Jersey City Free Public Library, presents a lecture series in celebration of the 250th Anniversary of the Declaration of Independence. For five months across the Spring and Summer of 2026, we will spend the first Thursday evening with a speaker on a wide range of Hudson County topics across our nation's first 250 years.

For the final event in the series, on September 3, Patrick Cullen presents:

Wayne's 1780 Attack on the Blockhouse

West New York historian Patrick Cullen will tell the story of Anthony Wayne's unsuccessful attack on the blockhouse that residents loyal to the British cause had constructed in what is now North Bergen and West New York. The story sheds light on the contested role of the heavily wooded areas of today's Hudson County as both side sought provisions in a "forage war."

Zentangle is a style of art consisting repeating patterns where the end result appears like an optical illusion. Young artists will be encouraged to trust their gut, relax, and make the pattern of the day their own!

Children and teens (between the ages of 6 and 17) are welcome to attend this free program which will be held in the Community Room (downstairs of the Heights Branch Library). Capacity is limited to the number of seats in the room (roughly 20).

Caretakers, if your child cannot be trusted with markers, they should not attend this event.

title: Storytime in the Heights
description:
Date: Wednesday, August 19, 2026
Time: 11:00am - 12:00pm
Location: Heights Branch

Join Miss Zoe (the new Heights Branch Children's Librarian) for an hour of singing, stories, and play. 

Children ages 0-5 are welcome!

11 am - Noon on Wednesdays in the Community Room (downstairs)

REGISTRATION REQUIRED (will open 3 days in advance, reminder email sent three hours in advance)

Following the Supercharged Storytimes framework, we will read roughly four books (sandwiched by songs) and spend the last twenty minutes on group social time (playing with blocks or coloring).

This event will run for ages 0-5 on Wednesdays at 11 am through August 26th. Beginning in September, we will hold storytime twice weekly: once for babies and toddlers ages 0-3 (Wednesdays at 10:30 am) and once for preschoolers and kindergarteners ages 3-5 (Tuesdays at 5 pm). Caretakers should not bring their children to both events in a given week.
